tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Window chrome: titlebar tab strip, vault rail, pane bars of unfocused panes. The darkest UI ground after the stage.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The terminal stage and recessed fields (input, textarea, code blocks). Same value as the xterm background so panes read as one surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default panel ground: vault body, host list, settings pages, toast and card fill in light.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that float above the surface: menus, dialogs, command palette, popovers, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted rows on any ground; the active rail item; the selected palette row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, panel edges, menu and dialog borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (input, select, checkbox, radio, secondary button). Holds 3:1 on surface and stage in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on chrome, stage, surface, raised and hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: host addresses, descriptions, inactive tabs, menu icons. 4.5:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, trailing shortcut hints. Reads 4.5:1 on stage, surface and raised; do not put it on chrome or hover in light.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Keel's one accent, used as a fill: primary button, the keel line under the active tab and focused pane, the terminal cursor, switch-on track, ⌘ key hints. Pair with on-brass text.

tokens.name: brass-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for brass surfaces (primary button hover).

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brass fill. 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass as text or a 2px mark on a neutral ground: focus rings, active rail icon, driver role label, selected palette icon. Darker in light so it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brass-ink text: driver chip, brass badge, selected snippet byte.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Live/connected state and success: the live dot, 'Connected' badge, tunnel running. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: tide-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind tide text (live badge).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Attention without failure: reconnecting, host key changed, 0.0.0.0 bind warning. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind signal text.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive: session dead, auth failed, Delete host, Stop runtime. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: flare-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind flare text and the resting fill of a danger button.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text on a solid flare fill (danger button hover).

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: Information and the follower role: 'Following', join links, info toasts.

tokens.name: haze-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind haze text (follower chip, info badge).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 1px offset, on every interactive element. Alias of brass-ink so it holds 3:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: xterm theme.background.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: xterm theme.foreground.

tokens.name: term-cursor
tokens.usage: xterm theme.cursor (block). Brass is the only warm color in a session view, so the cursor is always findable.

tokens.name: term-selection
tokens.usage: xterm selection background.

tokens.name: ansi-0
tokens.usage: ANSI 0 (black) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-1
tokens.usage: ANSI 1 (red) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-2
tokens.usage: ANSI 2 (green) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-3
tokens.usage: ANSI 3 (yellow) in the xterm theme. Same hue family as brass so shell prompts that use yellow feel native.

tokens.name: ansi-4
tokens.usage: ANSI 4 (blue) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-5
tokens.usage: ANSI 5 (magenta) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-6
tokens.usage: ANSI 6 (cyan) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-7
tokens.usage: ANSI 7 (white) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-8
tokens.usage: ANSI 8 (bright-black) in the xterm theme.

tokens.name: ansi-9
tokens.usage: ANSI 9 (bright-red) in the xterm theme. Also the host label palette: a host's tile color is one of ANSI 9–14.

tokens.name: ansi-10
tokens.usage: ANSI 10 (bright-green) in the xterm theme. Also the host label palette: a host's tile color is one of ANSI 9–14.

tokens.name: ansi-11
tokens.usage: ANSI 11 (bright-yellow) in the xterm theme. Also the host label palette: a host's tile color is one of ANSI 9–14.

tokens.name: ansi-12
tokens.usage: ANSI 12 (bright-blue) in the xterm theme. Also the host label palette: a host's tile color is one of ANSI 9–14.

tokens.name: ansi-13
tokens.usage: ANSI 13 (bright-magenta) in the xterm theme. Also the host label palette: a host's tile color is one of ANSI 9–14.

tokens.name: ansi-14
tokens.usage: ANSI 14 (bright-cyan) in the xterm theme. Also the host label palette: a host's tile color is one of ANSI 9–14.

tokens.name: ansi-15
tokens.usage: ANSI 15 (bright-white) in the xterm theme.

families.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the start screen. One per view.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog titles, vault page titles (Hosts, Keychain).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page, settings groups, toast titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each forward opens its own SSH connection.
styles.usage: Default UI text: menus, rows, descriptions, buttons. 1rem at the default UI size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row primary text, button labels, selected items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, small buttons, badges' bigger sibling.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Binding 0.0.0.0 exposes the port on every interface.
styles.usage: Help text under fields, toast descriptions, tooltips.

styles.name: term
styles.usage: Terminal text at the default size (⌘0). User range 10–22px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Snippet bodies, approve-before-type previews, commands in help text.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: user@host:port everywhere it appears: host rows, tab tooltips, pane bars.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in rail, palette and menus. Always uppercase, never sentences.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges, kbd cap inner gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu padding, gap between key caps, icon button inset.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons, tabs and state dots.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, gap inside a row, rail padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, gap between grouped controls, toast padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog and panel padding, gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and start-screen breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Key caps, badges, menu items, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, rail items, host tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, split panes' outer corners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: State dots, switch track, role chips.

size.note: Fixed chrome dimensions at the default 13px UI size; the app writes them in rem so ⌘± UI scaling keeps proportions.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Tab strip height (shares the macOS titlebar; 76px left inset for traffic lights).

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Tab height inside the strip.

tokens.name: size-panebar
tokens.usage: Pane header bar.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in pane bars and rows.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog primary actions, palette rows.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Host and key rows in vault lists.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Settings section rail width.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Vault sidebar width (left, collapsible, on every tab).

tokens.name: size-list
tokens.usage: List column of a list and detail tab page (Keychain, Snippets).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette, above the scrim.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills, focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, switch thumb.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, palette, toasts in and out.
